draft_note: Calculation spec from the city-expansion handoff. Not a publishable observation: no source is archived.
tax_note: Ongoing volumetric and fixed water charges are GST-free in Australia.
confirmed_absent: GST — water supply charges are GST-free
wastewater_note: Perth sewerage service charge is assessed on Gross Rental Value of the property. Property-value billing is Grade C under §5.2 and is not standardised.

reference_connection.designation: One annual water service charge, no size parameter in the modelled components.

superseded_note: Source capture completed 17 August 2026. Two things the draft could not know: the GST-free status rests on s 38-285 of the GST Act rather than on a general rule about Australian water, and Total Water Services must be withheld rather than reported equal to Water Supply — Perth assesses sewerage on Gross Rental Value by law.
